text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Equipment Sales AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × MOD × DEFENCE EQUIPMENT SALES MOD Defence Equipment Sales AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK defence equipment export sales — DE&S international sales, FMS cases, G2G frameworks, DIT DSO. Equipment lifecycle, offset obligations, export compliance. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Licensing Export Licensing — OGEL, OIEL, SIEL, ECJU OGEL for routine transfers. OIEL for repeat approved-destination shipments. SIEL for specific consignments. ECJU processing times and conditions. Military List classification — ML1–ML22. Arms Export Criteria — human rights, regional stability, diversion risk. Licence data for Parliamentary reporting. SIEL refusal grounds and appeal process. FMS Foreign Military Sales — US FMS, LOA, DSCA, ITAR FMS route for UK components in US-origin systems. LOA structure and lifecycle. DSCA oversight, Congressional notification thresholds ($14M/$50M). ITAR — US Munitions List categories. TAAs. Re-transfer restrictions. FMS surcharge. Offset exclusion. British defence content tracking in US programmes. G2G Government-to-Government — G2G Framework, MOD Sponsor G2G — MOD as contracting authority. DIT DSO support. MOD sponsor — requirement validation, pricing approval, delivery assurance. G2G vs DCS. Contract types — FFP, cost-plus, TCI. GFE provisions. DASA pricing methodology. Profit rates per SSRO baseline. Offset Offset & Industrial Participation — Tech Transfer Offset obligations — 50–100% contract value. Direct — co-production, subcontracting, tech transfer. Indirect — unrelated goods/services. Credit valuation — % FOB. ITAR/classified transfer limitations. NIP vs IP. Penalty clauses. Countertrade. Monitoring and enforcement. UK defence industrial base preservation. Support Through-Life Support — Spares, Training, Upgrades ISP — spares provisioning, tech pubs, training. CLS arrangements. PBL availability contracts. TLSA structure. Spares — rotables, consumables, obsolescence. Operator/maintainer training. Depot-level maintenance. Mid-life upgrade. Export-specific in-country support and remote diagnostics. Compliance Export Compliance — End-Use, Diversion, Sanctions EUC verification. Diversion risk — re-export, third-party transfer. OFSI sanctions screening. UN/EU/US sanctions lists. Arms Export Criteria (Consolidated Criteria). Country risk matrix. ECO post-shipment verification. Licence condition enforcement. PQ evidence on export decisions. Ministerial override record. CADMID CADMID Procurement — Concept to Disposal Concept — Initial Gate, URD. Assessment — Main Gate, cost, risk register. Demonstration — prototyping, TRLs. Manufacture — production contract, QA. In-service — support contract, obsolescence. Disposal — demilitarisation, environmental. IAC assurance. Whole-life cost modelling. Gateway reviews. Partnerships International Partnerships — Five Eyes, NATO, AUKUS Five Eyes interoperability. NATO STANAGs — equipment compatibility. AUKUS Pillar I (subs), Pillar II (advanced capabilities). Bilateral defence cooperation. COEP. Foreign Comparative Testing. NSPA. OCCAR. ITAR/GDF exemption pathways. Joint qualification/certification. Pricing Pricing & Costing — DASA, Profit Rates, SSRO DASA pricing methodology. SSCR — SSRO oversight. Baseline profit rate benchmark. Allowable costs — direct, indirect, capital. Profit rate adjustments — risk, performance, efficiency. CPR formula. Pricing Note submission. DefCred 7007 transparency. Reporting Regs 2015. Post-DLOD adjustments. Data Data Governance — Export Data, Classification ECJU database — licence application data. MOD/DE&S sales reporting. Classification — OFFICIAL through TOP SECRET. GSCP compliance.
